title: Filter the source record before FindFirst in Prices Overview caption
summary: The Prices Overview page now correctly displays captions by filtering records before lookup instead of performing an unfiltered search that returned unrelated first records.
key_points: GetFilterDescription() now applies SetFilter on the key field before FindFirst instead of just assigning the number
Fix covers the Customer, Customer Price Group, and Campaign branches
W1 page and its APAC layer copy were updated identically
Three regression tests check that the caption shows the selected record's name
Caption-only change with no schema, permission, or signature changes
